implementation_summary: POST /api/audits (AUDIT_API.start, owner, beta closed): owner check, body read capped at 16 KB, validateAuditStartBody -> 400 ERR_INVALID_AUDIT with fields; busy slot -> 409 before any network check; checkAuditAddress -> 400 ERR_PRIVATE_ADDRESS / 422 ERR_UNREACHABLE; synchronous RunSlot.begin(kind 'audit') -> 409 if refused; store.createAudit -> 202 {auditId, version}. The background run (runAuditVersion, exported for BE-603) uses a temp workDir and createPageRecorder, sends 'checking-address' then crawl progress (auditId and version added; currentPath already redacted by the crawl), then afterCrawl. Default afterCrawl is none in createAuditCrawlRoutes (marks the version done with crawl counts) and auditPipelineStep in auditCrawlRoutes (runAuditPipeline; no pacer; resolveAi errors become no-ai-key). Outcomes: stop -> 'stopped'; 'status-not-updated' -> retry done from the stored result, never marked failed; crawl error or save-failed -> 'failed' with fixed wording. workDir removed and slot released (kind 'audit' only) before the final event. GET /api/audits/:id/stream (AUDIT_API.stream, view, beta closed): AUDIT_ID_PATTERN and ?version checks, Helper view grant via mayUseAudit, unknown id -> 404 ERR_AUDIT_NOT_FOUND; data-only SSE; last event replayed first; stream ends after done/failed. Session state lives in AuditRun/AuditRuns (session/audit-run.ts).

risks: Contract gap: AUDIT_ERROR_CODES has no code for a stopped run or a storage failure. 'failed' events use ERR_UNREACHABLE for a crawl failure and ERR_INVALID_REQUEST (with a fixed message) for a stop or a save/status failure. Consider adding codes to packages/types (not my ownership).
AUDIT_API has no stop route; a stop is only possible through AuditRuns.get(id).stop() (for example at runner shutdown).

If the store cannot be written at all, updateVersion('failed'/'stopped') fails and the version stays 'running'. The same holds when 'status-not-updated' happens and the stored result cannot be read back. The stream still gets its final event.
The stream knows only runs held in memory (the running one plus the last 20 ended). After a runner restart a saved audit's stream answers 404; the get route still serves it.
No SSE heartbeat; a long quiet step behind a proxy with an idle timeout could drop the connection (EventSource reconnects and gets the last event again).
tsc -p packages/runner fails against out-of-date core build output (TS2367 on 'status-not-updated'); rebuild core first (pnpm build order).
The 'Check-up still accepts local Test Copy addresses' criterion is only covered at slot level here; the Check-up preflight was not changed.
handoff: BE-190: register with `...auditCrawlRoutes({ store, caller, runs, resolveAi, resolveServiceKey })` in routes/index.ts. `store` is the AuditStore; `caller` is the same as for the other audit rows; `runs` is one shared `new AuditRuns()` (from packages/runner/src/session/audit-run.ts), also given to BE-603; `resolveAi` is `() => resolveAuditAi(...)` with the saved setup and models; `resolveServiceKey` is the key resolver's resolveServiceKey for PageSpeed. The slot defaults to context.server.session.run. The afterCrawl default is auditPipelineStep (runAuditPipeline). BE-603: after slot.begin(id, url, 'audit') and store.addVersion, call `const run = runs.start(auditId, version.version); void runAuditVersion({ store, afterCrawl: auditPipelineStep({...}) }, { run, request, startedAt: version.startedAt, slot })`. runAuditVersion never throws, releases the slot and removes the working folder itself. The wizard's watchAudit works unchanged: data-only SSE, closed after done/failed.
